title: AI proposed code changes for PR 15337578
subtitle: repo: msazure/One/ZTS - source branch: feature/moaid/small-refactoring

content.body: This entry contains all code changes proposed by AI in the PowerReview session for Azure DevOps PR `15337578`. Each proposal below includes the exact unified diff so it can be reviewed directly in ActionView.

content.title: Proposal 1: Move RunVersion assignment after UpsertDataProcessAsync

content.body: Move `internalMetadata.RunVersion = runVersion;` from before `UpsertDataProcessAsync` to after it. This avoids persisting an incremented run version if the backend call fails, which would otherwise create non-sequential customer-visible run versions on retry.

content.title: Proposal 2: Convert expression-bodied methods to statement blocks

content.body: Convert `CreateUpsertRequest` and `ToWorkloadSegmentsV1` from expression-bodied members to statement blocks with explicit `return` statements for consistency with the surrounding code style.
